meta.technique: position-vs-content decomposition of bilinear attention patterns

metric_defs.R2_off: variance of raw pat explained by query-key OFFSET template
metric_defs.R2_cls: variance of raw pat explained by KEY-token-class template
metric_defs.R2_cls_resid: DECISIVE: content-class variance remaining AFTER offset removed
metric_defs.R2_off_resid: offset variance remaining after content removed (symmetric)
metric_defs.lastnl_frac: frac of queries (w/ prior newline) whose argmax==last-newline pos
metric_defs.bos_frac: frac of queries whose argmax==position 0 (abs-pos sink)
metric_defs.prev1_frac: frac of queries whose argmax==previous token (offset 1)

meta.honesty_note: A positional offset template fits the mean pattern of EVERY head (RoPE + causal mask). The decisive signal is R2_cls_resid ~= 0 (content adds nothing beyond position) together with causal load at structural positions. Expected result: most heads content-driven, a few genuinely positional.
